description: Create layers, set their properties and save the document.

identity.goal: Complete the create figure use case of figcraft using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the figcraft upstream of the craft-suite-api connector. Activate the namespace `figcraft` with registry_activate first; every tool below is namespaced figcraft_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `figcraft_inspect_document`, `figcraft_create_node`, `figcraft_set_properties`, `figcraft_save_file`. Steps: (1) Inspect the active document. (2) Create the layers. (3) Set their properties. (4) Save the document. Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the namespace figcraft was activated before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the app snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
